messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Rapid increase in external tool invocations and structured-output payload sizes. FN_CALL error rate 8% -> 18% in last 3m, worker CPU across us-west-2 at 92%, tail latency rising. Affected route: /v1/chat (all plans). Started 2026-03-17T01:02:14Z. Paging eng-oncall.
maya: oncall — looking. grabbing logs and tracing now. @sam @kevin can you join? :eyes:
sam: here. pulling runtime metrics. seeing continuous batching backlog growth + KV-cache thrash. suspect external tool call fanout from a handful of tenants.
kevin: SRE — checking infra pressure, OOMs on a few pods. starting targeted cordon/restart for the worst nodes.
maya: quick mitigation plan suggestion:
- apply tenant-scoped RPS caps for free and trial plans
- disable external tool/function call execution for all non-enterprise tenants
- reduce structured-output streaming window to 256 bytes for streaming responses
- enable fallback to local model-only path (no tool network) for in-flight requests
sam: agree. prioritizing minimal blast radius. I'll push a soft cap first for free-tier.
maya: exec to apply soft cap (running):
```bash
rbctl policy set-rate --scope tenant:plan:free --route /v1/chat --rps 0.5 --burst 1
```
sam: applied. monitoring.
support-lead-bot: Notifying support queue: "Investigation: elevated fncall errors, applied temporary throttles to free tier — may affect third-party tool integrations".
elaine: ops/RT queue — customers on enterprise plan seeing degraded streaming; enterprise unaffected by default caps, consider opt-in rollback if they request.
maya: next step: surgical disable of outbound tool execution for non-paid tiers. command I will run in control-plane (will be gradual across regions):
```json
{"action":"disable_tool_exec","scope":"tenant:plan:free,tenant:plan:trial","reason":"runtime overload 92% cpu"}
```
sam: staging run looks good; will promote in 30s window per region. hooking in fallback model variant: `model-routing:local-only-v2`.
kevin: infra side — bumped autoscaler cooldown to 60s to avoid churn, drained 2 nodes with highest memory pressure.
maya: rolling disable now region us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. executing.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: disable_tool_exec applied for tenant:plan:free in us-west-2 at 01:06:35Z.
sam: confirmed drop in outbound egress and CPU trending down to 60% in affected pool. fncall error rate down to 3%.
elaine: need customer impact assessment thread: support queue is triaging top 5 tenants with high fncall usage. preparing templated comms. suggested message: "We've temporarily disabled third-party tool calls for free/trial plans to protect service stability. Paid customers unaffected — reach support for exceptions." :paperclip:
support-lead-bot: Draft sent to #support-drafts for review. ETA 10m.
maya: additional guard — reduce structured-output max streaming chunk: `rbctl config set structured_output.max_chunk 256` to limit CPU decode thrash.
sam: applied. stream sizes dropped ~40% and worker latencies normalized.
kevin: rolling restarts complete for the two worst nodes; pod ready counts back to 98%.
maya: telemetry shows overall per-token cost dropped and tail p99 latency returning to baseline. keeping caps for 15m then reassess.
elaine: recommend we schedule a short customer-facing status page update once support draft approved.
support-lead-bot: status page draft: "Temporary restriction on external tool/function calls for free/trial customers due to high system load. We're monitoring and will update in 30 mins." posted to review.
sam: handing over monitoring to kevin for infra and to elaine for comms. I'll stay on the thread for rollback window.
maya: handing on-call to sam for the next 2 hours (I have a sequence to run). Sam please escalate to oncall lead if we see >5% fncall errors again.
sam: ack. set new alert: fncall_error_rate > 5% for 5m -> page eng-sre.
kevin: noted. creating runbook entry: "surgical-tool-disable-2026-03-17" with steps taken and rollback instructions.
maya: notes for postmortem: root cause likely runaway external tool loop from a single orchestrator tenant; need better per-tenant circuit breaker and cost-aware routing. queue Eval team to add prompt-level injection guards.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, service degradation contained. Next update scheduled in 20m or on new trigger. Incident severity: sev2. Logged to #incidents.
maya: thanks team. I'll add playbook links and hand off to sam/elaine for customer comms and incident writeup.
sam: thanks — monitoring. :thumbsup:
elaine: preparing summary for leadership, will include tenant list and potential credit plan for impacted customers.
support-lead-bot: Support queue updated. Templates ready.
maya: closing active triage; leaving thread open for followups.
